title: pvRemoveGhostInformation
body:
## pvRemoveGhostInformation

Removes ghost cells and the vtkGhostType point and cell arrays from polydata or unstructured grids; for hyper tree grids it removes the ghost array and masks the ghost cells. Use it before writing or measuring data from a parallel pipeline so duplicated boundary layers are not exported or counted twice.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only polydata, unstructured grid and hyper tree grid inputs are accepted; for structured data use pvExtractSubset to trim ghost layers.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `RemoveGhostInformation`. Identity: `filters/RemoveGhostInformation`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the remove ghost information filter. This filter operates on unstructured grids and polydata since it removes the ghost cells. It also supports HTGs, in which case it simply masks ghost cells. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData); unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData","vtkUnstructuredGrid","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
